missing_claims.claim: Exact iPCRTag index member used for each Smallwood library
missing_claims.evidence: Smallwood Methods names indexed iPCRTag but no sample-to-member mapping was located; Quail table establishes family, not chosen member.

conclusion: Smallwood original and supplements, cited Quail iPCRTag table, later Clark full article/supplement, official GEO family SOFT, and Miura PBAT predecessor now have two independent located reads. The 2017 optimization is not the 2014 chemistry: it changes N9 to N6 and replaces streptavidin capture with SPRI. GEO confirms N9 and generic indexed-iPCRTag workflow but no per-sample member allocation. Exact Smallwood cell-to-index assignment remains blocked; the model uses a variable eight-base member.
